raw_text: PSA: The 'Chinese Andaman invasion plan' going viral on Twitter and Telegram is from a WAR GAME thread on IndianDefenceForum.com. It's literally a fictional strategy game called 'Operation Crimson Tide' that's been running for months. The original post is clearly labelled [WAR GAME SCENARIO - FICTION] at the top and bottom. Someone screenshotted the middle paragraphs without the disclaimers. I found the original thread — link in comments. Please stop sharing this as real intelligence.
clean_text: Reddit user traces viral Andaman invasion plan to fictional war game thread on IndianDefenceForum.com called Operation Crimson Tide. Original clearly labelled as fiction. Screenshots cropped out disclaimers. Urges people to stop sharing as real intelligence.
